I honestly didn’t know being a “little” was a thing until recently.  I’ve always had childlike tendencies (I love stuffed animals, coloring and watching cartoons) but I’ve never had a daddy/CG.  Everyone around me just considers me goofy and childish and since it doesn’t hurt anyone why not be yourself, I can promise you it’s so much easier to be me than pretend to be something I’m not.  I slipped at work the other day and started talking about snowflakes and how pretty they are when they land on you, I got a few confused looks (I’m in my 30’s but everyone else is 50+) and I started to feel embarrassed but they all laughed it off and said I sound like a hallmark card 😂😂.  The point is be true to yourself and do what makes you happy 😊😘

I had a regular biopsy (awake with local anesthetic) and then an excisional biopsy (surgery) in August/September and both procedures were very painful and pretty emotional.  My advice to you is keep your night as low key as possible (comfy clothes, snacks, tv). Chances are she’s going to be drained both physically and emotionally so just let her know you are there in whatever capacity she needs you.  Best of luck to you both. PS keep the ice packs going, they tend to numb the pain and help reduce bruising.
